investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin rebounds to $90K+ by Q4 2026 as midterm regulatory fears fade and macro eases, but spot ETF adoption caps upside; long BTC spot via Grayscale Bitcoin Mini Trust (BTC) with 5-month horizon.
supporting_signals: CNBC: BTC at $76K is oversold on tech-driven selloff, not fundamental shift
CoinDesk: Bitcoin tumble tied to collapsing AI trade, not crypto-specific catalyst
BBC: Democratic socialists win LA/NYC but have no explicit crypto policy; moratorium calls are broad, not Bitcoin-specific
investment_theses.counter_view: National AI data center moratorium could trigger cascading energy/power concerns, prolonging crypto bearishness; Fed keeps rates higher-for-longer, crushing leverage.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC spot via Grayscale Bitcoin Mini Trust or Polymarket long-BTC-$90K contract; hedge with short 3x BTC perps on Deribit if moratorium chatter accelerates

supporting_signals: Cointelegraph: Core Scientific, American Bitcoin pivot away from mining; AI capex surge absorbs PoW energy
CNBC: Top Dems call AI moratorium post-midterms; regulatory overhang on data centers will spill into DeFi scrutiny
CoinDesk: Kraken/Payward AAVE push and crypto insurance funding (Soter $23.5M) show DeFi builders hedging regulatory risk
investment_theses.counter_view: Ethereum spots strong institutional demand; staking rewards and L2 Dencun upgrades drive adoption; ETH/BTC could actually outperform if macro eases.
investment_theses.expression: Short ETH/BTC ratio via dYdX perpetual or Deribit futures; or short 2x ETH, long 1x BTC on FTX/Kraken spot margin
